sources.description: Git repository for the call-the-match project
Testing PRD with reorganization and required test categories
Testing plan with reorganization-first phased breakdown
School JUnit and MockMvc guideline slides for Spring MVC controller tests.
School multiple-row MVC guideline slides with controller, path-variable and not-found test patterns.
School security guideline slides for form login, role access and security test expectations.
School REST guideline slides for REST controller behavior and JSON-focused tests.
Exercise MVC controller test example for status, view, model and error-path assertions.
Exercise security test example for protected routes and role-aware access.
Primary exercise REST controller test example with MockMvc, jsonPath and REST error assertions.

tasks.title: Reorganisatie – Verplaats Bestaande Tests Naar Juiste Packages
tasks.description: Move all existing test classes to the school-conform package structure. No new test logic – only move files, update package declarations, and rename where needed. Moves: AccessSecurityMvcTests → security/AccessSecurityTests, PublicBrowseMvcTests → controller/PublicBrowseControllerTests, TeamManagementMvcTests → controller/TeamControllerTests, MatchManagementMvcTests → controller/CompetitionControllerTests, PredictionMvcTests → controller/PredictionControllerTests, dto/InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests → validation/InputRegistrationDTOValidationTests, dto/InputTeamDTOValidationTests → validation/InputTeamDTOValidationTests, dto/InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests → validation/InputCompetitionDTOValidationTests, dto/InputPredictionDTOValidationTests → validation/InputPredictionDTOValidationTests, validator/CompetitionValidatorTests → validation/CompetitionValidatorTests. Delete old files after move. service/ tests remain untouched. CallTheMatchApplicationTests stays in root package.
acceptance_criteria: All moved tests compile and pass after relocation
Package declarations are updated correctly in each moved file
Old files in root package and dto/validator/ subpackages are deleted
service/ tests remain untouched at their current location
CallTheMatchApplicationTests remains in root package
mvn test passes fully after reorganization

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – AccountController (nieuw)
tasks.description: Create src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/AccountControllerTests.java using @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc. Test GET /register (status 200, view account/register, model has inputRegistrationDto), GET /login (status 200, view account/login), POST /register with valid data (redirect to login), POST /register with invalid data (returns view account/register with field errors), POST /register without CSRF token (403).
acceptance_criteria: GET /register returns status 200 with view name account/register and model attribute inputRegistrationDto
GET /login returns status 200 with view name account/login
POST /register with valid params redirects to login or success page
POST /register with blank/invalid params returns view account/register with field errors
POST /register without CSRF token returns 403
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/controller/ package

tasks.title: MVC Controller Tests – Aanvullingen
tasks.description: Review the moved MVC controller tests in controller/ package and supplement missing scenarios. Ensure each controller test covers at minimum: happy path, validation error return to view, redirect after success, and model attributes. CompetitionControllerTests must cover GET list, GET detail, GET not-found (404), admin add flow (valid + invalid), USER access denied. TeamControllerTests must cover dashboard, create (valid + invalid + duplicate), join (valid + invalid), detail (member vs non-member), owner-only actions. PredictionControllerTests must cover prediction submit flows.
acceptance_criteria: CompetitionControllerTests covers GET list, GET detail, GET not-found 404, admin add valid+invalid, USER 403
TeamControllerTests covers dashboard, create valid+invalid+duplicate, join valid+invalid, detail member vs non-member, owner-only actions
PredictionControllerTests covers prediction submit flows
All tests pass with mvn test

tasks.title: Security Tests – Uitbreiden
tasks.description: Extend the moved security/AccessSecurityTests with missing access verifications. Ensure coverage of: guest accessing public routes (200), guest redirected to /login for user-only routes, USER accessing /team/dashboard and /predictions (200), USER getting 403 on admin routes, ADMIN accessing /competition/add (200), ADMIN getting 403 on user-only routes, form-login with correct/incorrect credentials, logout redirect to /login?logout, POST without CSRF returns 403.
acceptance_criteria: Guest can access /home, /ranking, /competition/{id}, /login, /register with status 200
Guest accessing /team/dashboard is redirected to /login
USER can access /team/dashboard with status 200
USER accessing /competition/add gets 403
ADMIN can access /competition/add with status 200
ADMIN accessing /team/dashboard gets 403
Form-login with correct email and password results in authenticated session
Form-login with incorrect credentials redirects to /login?error
Logout redirects to /login?logout
POST without CSRF token returns 403

tasks.title: Validatie Tests – Aanvullingen Bestaande Annotaties
tasks.description: Review moved validation tests in validation/ package and supplement missing positive/negative cases. Add InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests if missing. Ensure each DTO validation test has both positive (valid input = 0 violations) and negative (invalid input = expected violations) cases. All tests must use jakarta.validation.Validator without Spring context.
acceptance_criteria: Each DTO validation test has both positive and negative cases
InputTeamJoinDTOValidationTests exists and tests blank inviteCode
All tests use jakarta.validation.Validator without Spring context
Test classes are in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ package

tasks.title: Validatie Tests – Custom Annotatie & Validator Klasse
tasks.description: Create test class(es) in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ for custom annotation validator(s). Directly instantiate the ConstraintValidator implementation class. Call initialize() if needed. Call isValid(value, context) with a Mockito-mocked ConstraintValidatorContext. Verify: isValid with valid value returns true, isValid with invalid value returns false, isValid with null returns true (null-safe convention). At least one custom annotation + validator class must be fully tested.
acceptance_criteria: Validator class is instantiated directly without Spring context
isValid(validValue, mockContext) returns true
isValid(invalidValue, mockContext) returns false
isValid(null, mockContext) returns true (null-safe convention)
ConstraintValidatorContext is mocked with Mockito
At least 1 custom annotation validator is fully tested
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/validation/ package

tasks.title: REST Controller Tests
tasks.description: Create test class(es) in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/restcontroller/ for REST endpoints once they exist. Use @WebMvcTest or @SpringBootTest + @AutoConfigureMockMvc with MockMvc. Test: GET on public REST endpoint returns 200 with JSON body, GET on non-existing resource returns 404, POST/PUT/DELETE without authentication returns 401 or 403, POST with valid JSON as authorized user returns 201 or 200, POST with invalid JSON returns 400 with validation errors. Verify JSON structure with jsonPath assertions.
acceptance_criteria: GET on public REST endpoint returns 200 with JSON body verified by jsonPath
GET on non-existing resource returns 404
POST/PUT/DELETE without authentication returns 401 or 403
POST with valid JSON body as authorized user returns 201 or 200
POST with invalid JSON body returns 400 with validation error details
JSON response structure is verified with jsonPath assertions
Test class is in src/test/java/com/example/callthematch/restcontroller/ package
